sections.heading: WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO PLAY
sections.middleText1: two single or multi-message switches record: "stick" on one switch "twist" on the other

sections.heading: HOW TO PLAY
sections.body:
1. Deal two cards to everyone in a game of Blackjack (21).
2. The switch user adds up their card values and decides their move.
3. On their turn, the switch user says "stick" (stop) or "twist" (get 1 card) using their switches.
4. Carry on playing until everyone "sticks" or goes bust.
5. Closest player to 21 without going bust wins!
